empty_body: No failed tool calls, no blocked callers to review, no missed calls in the last day. An empty page here is the normal state — if it stays empty for a week, the agent is doing its job.
error_offline_title: The server could not be reached
intro: Two kinds of thing live here. The ones at the top are waiting on a decision only a person can make; the rest are a record of what happened while nobody was watching.
log_allowed_body: Blocked by the spam list, released by Sabine. The number has called twice since.
log_backup_body: 1.4 GB to the business NAS. Recordings older than 90 days were deleted first.
log_calendar_body: CalDAV returned 409 on a double booking. The agent offered the caller a different slot instead of failing the call.
log_missed_body: Nobody was expected — the out-of-hours assistant took a message and it was read the next morning.
log_sip_body: sip.easybell.de accepted the registration after 4 minutes offline. Two calls rang out during the gap.
log_summary_body: 18 calls, 14 handled by the agent, 2 transferred, 2 missed.
log_webhook_body: n8n.local accepted the third retry of tool.failed. Nothing was lost.
marked_read: {count} moved out of the log. Still waiting on a decision: {waiting}.
msg_agent_notification: The agent flagged something for you mid-conversation.
msg_backup_failed: The nightly backup did not run.
msg_backup_no_target: No backup target is set, so no backup is being taken at all.
msg_backup_unverified: A backup was written, but reading it back to check it failed.
msg_channel_down: The {channel} channel lost its connection. Customers writing there are not being answered.
msg_mail_failed: An email could not be sent.
msg_restore_staged: A restore from {taken_at} is staged and will run on the next restart.
msg_routed_to_person: A rule handed this conversation to a person.
msg_transfer_requested: The agent asked for a person to take a conversation over.
msg_web_chat_started: Somebody started a chat on your website: “{preview}”
nothing_to_mark: There was nothing in the log to clear.
open_blocked_body: +43 720 887 221 matched a blocking rule and was hung up on after 4 seconds. If this was a customer, loosen the rule.
open_blocked_title: A caller was blocked by the “unknown mobile prefixes” rule
open_disabled_body: The agent was switched off for maintenance on Monday morning and no fallback was configured, so both callers heard the line ring out.
open_disabled_title: Two calls arrived while the agent was disabled
open_sms_body: The agent told her a confirmation SMS was on its way, then send_notification timed out against the gateway. She is expecting a message that does not exist.
open_sms_title: SMS confirmation was never delivered to Anna Gruber
retention_note: Kept for thirty days, then deleted. Which of these also reach you by email is set per type — failures always do, whatever else you switch off.
title: Notifications
untranslated_note: Notification text is written by whatever raised it and is not translated.
